title: NPT RevCon 폐회(5/22) — 4주간 회기 종료, 5대 쟁점 미해결, 컨센서스 결과문서 채택 실패 가능성 높음
snippet: The 11th NPT Review Conference (April 27 - May 22, 2026) concluded its four-week session. The conference faced five major unresolved issues: the Iran war and nuclear facility strikes, Iran's NPT withdrawal bill, nuclear disarmament (P5 non-cooperation), Ukraine (Zaporizhzhia), and CTBT entry into force. Multiple sources assessed that consensus on a final outcome document was unlikely, pointing to a potential fourth consecutive failure after 2005, 2015, and 2022. The last successful consensus outcome was 2010. ELN noted that despite overall failure prospects, Pillar III (peaceful uses) showed progress.
tag_reason: 5/22 보고서의 'NPT RevCon D-Day' 항목의 후속. 5/22에 폐회가 예정되어 있었고, 오늘(5/23) 회의가 공식 종료. 합의 실패 가능성이 높다는 판단이 여러 소스에서 확인됨. ELN의 Pillar III 성과 분석은 새로운 관점.
